Subject: Kickoff: SOC 2 walk + DPA review + pen-test scoping

Hi Markus / Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — ClearPay's security team would like to move forward with a compliance walkthrough to review the SOC 2 surface area, DPA terms, and pen-test expectations before we lock a production rollout date. We expect 2–3 folks from our side: myself (security sponsor), Avery Jennings (engineering lead), and our procurement specialist (for contract alignment).

High-level asks:
- 60–75 minute walkthrough covering: SOC 2 scope & evidence mapping, DPA key clauses (data flows, subprocessor list), and expected pen-test timing / vendor access model.
- Any pre-read (controls mapping, evidence index) would be helpful.
- We are in Dublin (IST / UTC+1). Our preferred windows next week: 2026-06-22 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–17:00 local. We can flex to an earlier morning if you have EMEA coverage.

Attaching our brief summary of desired agenda. Let me know who from Redwood should be on the call and suggest 2-3 candidate slots.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connell
Head of InfoSec, ClearPay
liam.oconnell@clearpay.io
